subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should `captionedFinalText` become a public channel Plugin SDK capability that authorizes core to suppress live text and own caption plus fallback delivery?
rationale: This is a permanent extension-facing compatibility and message-delivery contract; code correctness alone cannot establish whether maintainers want that ownership boundary.

options.title: Accept the generic capability
options.body: Keep the opt-in API and require exact-head Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the repair Telegram-owned
options.body: Narrow the implementation to the bundled Telegram channel and defer a public API until another channel demonstrates the need.

options.title: Pause caption deferral
options.body: Do not change final-mode delivery until the desired captioned-versus-separate TTS policy is settled.

recommendation.title: Accept the generic capability
recommendation.body: Keep the opt-in API and require exact-head Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant merged history crosses core dispatch, Plugin SDK, and bundled Telegram ownership boundaries.
